newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Morgan Grenfell sells SinterCast stake.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Grenfell sells SinterCast stake.

text.p: Morgan Grenfell Asset Management Ltd said on Monday it sold its entire stake in Swedish casting equipment group SinterCast AB, corresponding to 35 percent of capital and 40.7 percent of the votes.

Morgan Grenfell sold 807,342 series A shares and 1,700 series B shares which it held on behalf of public funds and sold them via placing, it said in a statement. It also sold 621,314 series A shares held on behalf of funds via a placing.

Four subsidiaries of Deutsche Bank AG, incorporated in Luxembourg, continue to hold and may cast votes carried by 325,825 SinterCast series A shares and 609,900 series B shares amounting to 22.9 percent of capital and 11 percent of votes.
